question: Three products,______,______ and ______ are produced in chlor-alkali process.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Hydrogen, Chlorine, NaOH**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The **chlor-alkali process** is an industrial method used to produce three main products: **Hydrogen, Chlorine, and Sodium Hydroxide (NaOH).**
 
• The process involves the electrolysis of a **concentrated aqueous solution of sodium chloride (brine)**.
 
• Hydrogen gas is produced at the cathode, while chlorine gas is produced at the anode during the electrolysis.
 
• Sodium hydroxide is formed in the solution as a by-product and is separated for industrial use.
 
• The chlor-alkali products are widely used in industries such as chemicals, textiles, paper, and water purification.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Electrolysis Process:**

 
 
• Electrolysis is a chemical process in which electrical energy is used to drive a non-spontaneous chemical reaction.
 
• In the chlor-alkali process, brine (sodium chloride solution) acts as the electrolyte.
 
 
 
• **Applications of Chlorine:**
 
 
• Chlorine is used in the production of PVC (Polyvinyl Chloride), disinfectants, and bleaching agents.
 
• It is also employed for water purification and sanitation purposes.
 
 
 
• **Applications of Sodium Hydroxide:**
 
 
• Sodium hydroxide (caustic soda) is used in the manufacture of paper, textiles, soap, and detergents.
 
• It is also utilized in processes like water treatment and refining petroleum products.
 
 
 
• **Environmental Considerations:**
 
 
• The chlor-alkali process requires careful handling of chlorine gas due to its toxic and corrosive nature.
 
• Modern plants employ membrane cell technology to reduce environmental impact and improve efficiency.
